styleLock.backgroundSystem: one continuous seamless sweep: base white #FFFFFF for packshots and macro, warm off-white #F5F2EC for group and lifestyle, cool light grey #ECEFF2 board for lineup and grid screens; never gradient, never tinted
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadow under every item, small controlled speculars on metal ends, no dramatic shadow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep in base white #FFFFFF or warm off-white #F5F2EC, cool light grey #ECEFF2 board when a grid or lineup needs separation from the backdrop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; in-image copy reduced to empty headline bands and bracketed label slots, all marketing wording carried by placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons plus plain check and dash marks in amber #E0912F on cool light grey #ECEFF2 hairline rails

noDrift: no invented spec numbers or badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium utilitarian 3C-accessory visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless base white #FFFFFF, warm off-white #F5F2EC, cool light grey #ECEFF2 and one amber accent #E0912F; neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, bounce fill and soft contact shadows only, small controlled speculars on metal ends; modern geometric sans-serif; hairline rails and thin single-weight icons in the same amber accent; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic components; stable upright product angle, even spacing and consistent scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 多枚同规格圆柱电芯错落成排站立、前方一枚横卧，纯白无缝底；002 单枚直立正面白底；003 单枚斜卧露出正极端头金属帽与卷边；004 同系列多规格（含扁方块型与细短型）成排并列白底；005 四栏规格对照信息图，橙色标题与勾叉符号、米黄交替行带，栏内为容量/电压/温度/年限等具体数值；006 浅色木桌上多规格堆叠全家福，背景虚化家居物。品类判定依据：产品为无电加热无电机的化学干电池，家用电器不合；家居日用下 11 个中类无电池位；家装灯具/电工偏安装件，故按消费 3C 电池的常见挂类定为手机数码/数码配件，源平台类目路径仅作线索不改写结论。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与系列名、包装配色字样、原平台店铺字样与评级角标、005 表内全部数值与年限/循环次数/容量/电压/温度主张（改为空白参数格与勾叉位）、004 与 006 的规格型号字符、003 端头与壳体上的印刷字样；产品一律以 {product} 占位，仅保留机位、光位、背景与排版结构。
